description:
Deletes a plan-only team and their planning settings.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The ID of the plan-only team.
parameters.name: planOnlyTeamId

204.description: Returned if the request is successful.

401.description: Returned if the user is not logged in.

403.description: Returned if the site has no premium edition of Jira or if the user does not have the Administer Jira global permission.

404.description: Returned if the plan or plan-only team is not found, or the plan-only team is not associated with the plan.

409.description: Returned if the plan is not active.
